pages.note: Rebuilt 2026-09-15 as a card grid driven by snippets/used-by.jsx. Verified each card: package.json dependency on extension (better-lyrics ^4.1.5, ApolloAuto/apollo dreamview-debug-extension latest, apades/dmMiniPlayer packages/element-picker-ext ^4.0.32, debpalash/Opal extension ^3.0.0) through the GitHub contents API; versions from the Firefox Add-ons and Edge Add-ons APIs for Better Lyrics (2.3.3) and from each manifest.json for the others (Opal Connect 0.4.0, Dreamview 1.0, element picker 1.0.0); Chrome Web Store, Firefox Add-ons and Edge Add-ons listing URLs, betterlyrics.org and opal.palash.dev all answered 200. dmMiniPlayer's store extension builds with Vite and esbuild, so that card names the element picker package and links source only, never the store listing. Opal Connect and Dreamview have no store listing, so their cards link source (and website for Opal) only. Icons and screenshots come from each project's repository or official store listing.
Parity with the English twin: same card grid component with the locale prop, same add-your-project instructions and example object, translated prose and descriptions.
